# @three-ws/marketplace-mcp

> Browse the three.ws agent marketplace and skills catalog from any AI agent. browse_agents and browse_skills search & page the public listings; agent_detail and the category tools round out discovery. Read-only — no key, no signer, no payment.

@three-ws/marketplace-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/marketplace-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/nft-marketplace-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/nft-marketplace-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/nft-marketplace-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/nft-marketplace-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
